scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp index.html privacy.html manifest.json sw.js icon-192.png icon-512.png apple-touch-icon.png www/ && cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/capacitor.js www/ && node -e "const f='www/index.html',fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!s.includes('<script>'))process.exit(1);fs.writeFileSync(f,s.replace('<script>','<script src=\"capacitor.js\"></script>\n<script>'))"
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
